sloka: यथेष्टं भुङ्क्ष्व लोकांस्त्रीन्निगृह्यारातिमोजसा ।वृथा किं ते श्रमेणेह युद्धमद्य तु निष्फलम् ।। ७.२९.३७ ॥
transliteration: yatheṣṭaṁ bhuṅkṣva lokāṁstrīnnigṛhyārātimojasā ।vṛthā kiṁ te śrameṇeha yuddhamadya tu niṣphalam ।। 7.29.37 ॥

translations.english: Enjoy the three worlds to your heart's content, having subdued the enemy with your might; why exert yourself in vain here, for today's battle is indeed fruitless.
